verdict.rationale: LangGraph is open-source and persists state via checkpointers you control (e.g., PostgresSaver into your own Postgres database), meaning data inherently resides in an open, self-owned format rather than a vendor silo — implying no lock-in. However, there is no explicit documentation or feature framed as 'export your data and leave,' no data-portability guarantees, and no mention of export tooling for LangGraph Platform/Agent Server-hosted state. Missing for 10: explicit data export/portability documentation, confirmation for hosted Agent Server deployments, and any statement addressing leaving the platform without data loss.
